_schema._about: Every nav string and href (CONTRACT §3). Slugs under /services/ and /solutions/ are defined here and are canonical for the whole site — the services, solutions and footer agents read them from this file. Clean URLs, no trailing slash, no .html.
_schema.logo: {href, onDark, onLight, alt}. Centre lockup: -on-dark on dark pages, -on-light on sand/white pages (the engine flips data-nav). Min 160px wide.
_schema.left: array[5] in order: Services, Solutions, Pricing, Work, Resources. {label, type: 'menu' | 'link', menu (key into menus) | href}. Pricing links to the homepage #pricing section; Rights lives in the Resources menu.
_schema.right: array[1]. {label, href, primary: true}: the one booking button in the top bar, a solid jam pill with black text on every background. Creators reach /join from the Resources menu, the phone menu and the footer, never from the top bar (it competed with the booking button on phones).
_schema.menus.services: the reference site's Product menu: {columns[2]: array of {label, desc (~7 words), href}, newCard: {tag, title, desc, href, cta}}. 4 + 4 items plus the 'New' card = the nine services.
_schema.menus.solutions: the reference site's Solutions menu: {columns[2]: {heading, items: [{label, desc, href}]}} — 'By goal' (6) and 'By brand' (3).
_schema.menus.resources: {items[6]: {label, href}, card: {label, sub, href, image, alt, tag}}: Agency, Process, Rights, FAQ, Blog, For creators. The card is a still of an example template document, tagged 'Example'.
_schema.mobile: {toggle, close, items[10]}: Services, Solutions (accordions), then Pricing, Work, Agency, Process, Rights, FAQ, Blog, For creators (links; the last is set quieter). The mobile bar keeps right[] (Book a call) and the lockup.
